item.title: Jealousy allegedly leads to the stabbing of a 32-year-old woman in Cebu City -- police
item.description: A 32-year-old woman died after being stabbed by her live-in partner--reportedly due to jealousy--in Sitio Asuphua, Barangay Basak San Nicolas, Cebu City, yesterday morning, Wednesday, October 28, 2026, DYSS Super Radyo GMA's Decemay Padilla reported.

item.title: Netanyahu, at risk of losing power, steps up attacks on Israel's Arab parties
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu alleged, without providing evidence, that Arab parties' record gains in an election this week were driven in part by voter fraud. Arab leaders accused him of incitement.

item.title: Foreign Affairs Secretary Lazaro conducts humanitarian mission in Myanmar
item.description: Foreign Affairs Secretary Theresa Lazaro on Thursday conducted a humanitarian mission in Myanmar and with Union Minister for Foreign Affairs U Tin Maung Swe discussed expanding assistance delivered to affected and hard-to-reach areas.

item.title: Who will be Bangsamoro's first elected Chief Minister?
item.description: Abdulraof Macacua and Ahod Balawag Ebrahim, the present and former interim chief ministers of the Bangsamoro Transition Authority, have emerged as the top contenders for the post as first elected chief minister when members of the Bangsamoro parliament vote on Friday, October 30. Who will be BARMM's first elected chief minister?

item.title: No lockdown but security tight for BARMM Parliament's inaugural session
item.description: Authorities emphasized that there is no lockdown in Cotabato City, but heightened security measures are actively in place ahead of the inaugural session of the Bangsamoro Parliament.

item.title: Safe access sought for PWDs in cemeteries during Undas
item.description: The National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) urged local government units (LGU) to ensure that persons with disabilities (PWD) have safe access to cemeteries during the Undas season.

item.title: PCG probes object aboard vessel in Bajo de Masinloc
item.description: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) is investigating the capabilities and purpose of unidentified equipment aboard a vessel spotted inside the lagoon of Bajo de Masinloc in the West Philippine Sea.

item.title: Floodwaters persist in Dagupan cemetery as Undas nears
item.description: A cemetery in Dagupan City remains flooded from the past Southwest Monsoon or Habagat season, with only a few days left before Undas.

item.title: KILALANIN: Babaeng embalsamador na isa ring nursing student
item.description: Viral sa social media kamakailan ang isang 18-anyos na babae na nakapasa sa isang licensure exam. Bukod sa pagiging maganda, kakaiba ang napili niyang propesyon na karaniwang panglalaki --ang pagiging embalsamador.

item.title: Survey period didn't cover hearings on alleged unexplained wealth, says prosecutor
item.description: The House prosecution panel has no reason to be demoralized amid the latest Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey showing that 35% of Filipinos are dissatisfied with the prosecution of the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte, House prosecution panel spokesperson Zia Adiong of Lanao del Sur said Thursday.

item.title: Multo at elemento, ano ang pinagkaiba at paano sila magpaparamdam?
item.description: Nahuli-cam ng netizens ang iba"t ibang karanasan nila ng mga kababalaghan gaya ng paggalaw ng mga upuan, pagpapakita ng misteryosong lalaki, at pagtawag ng mga tinig na nagdulot sa kanila ng katatakutan. Ano kaya ang paliwanag ng isang paranormal expert tungkol dito? Alamin.

item.title: Who is to blame for Hong Kong's deadly 2025 fire?
item.description: An independent Hong Kong committee blamed a renovation contractor and consultant as well as four government departments for a deadly blaze that killed 168 people in the city last November.

item.title: Southeast Asian defense ministers aim for proactive engagement amid security threats --Teodoro
item.description: Southeast Asian defense ministers have agreed to be more proactive in engaging as security threats become more unpredictable, said Department of National Defense (DND) Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Thursday.

item.title: 'More than courteous' for PH usec to meet China defense attache --Teodoro
item.description: DND Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said it"s “more than courteous” that another department executive has welcomed China"s defense attache during the ADMM-Plus meeting in Cebu.

item.title: Spanish rescuers search for victims as train crash death toll rises to 69
item.description: URDA, Spain - Rescuers picked through mangled carriages on Thursday in a grim search for victims of Spain's second fatal high-speed train crash this year, as the death toll rose to 69 and hopes of finding further survivors faded.
